title: AWS Administrator
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

glish fluently

An AWS Administrator specializing in Kubernetes, particularly with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), requires a robust set of skills encompassing both cloud infrastructure and container orchestration

AWS Services:

Proficiency in core AWS services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, EBS, and EFS. Understanding how these integrate with EKS is crucial.


Networking:

Strong understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, NACLs, and routing tables, and how they apply to Kubernetes clusters.


Security:

Knowledge of AWS security best practices, IAM roles and policies, and securing EKS clusters.


Automation & Scripting:

Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automating AWS tasks and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., using CloudFormation or Terraform).

Kubernetes Fundamentals:

Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including control plane components (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager) and worker node components (kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime).


Containerization:

Expertise in Docker or other container runtimes, including image building, registry management, and container best practices.


Workload Management:

Ability to deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes objects like Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.


Networking:

Understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI plugins, Service networking, Ingress controllers, and DNS resolution within the cluster.


Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.


Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.


Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.


Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.


CI/CD:

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Business Systems Analyst
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Business Systems Analyst to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Contract

Location: Remote - Brazil

Industry: IT & Services, Data & Analytics.


Business Systems Analyst | About You

As a Business Systems Analyst, you are responsible for supporting the success of a Pay-Per-Use program by identifying, triaging, and resolving data and process discrepancies tied to financial operations. You bring a strong analytical mindset, an understanding of how data flows across systems, and the ability to work cross-functionally across technical and business teams. You’re comfortable navigating reporting systems, investigating issues, and ensuring data accuracy that supports key financial processes such as billing and revenue recognition. While you don’t interact directly with external clients, your work plays a critical role in maintaining operational efficiency and enabling clean financial outcomes. You are detail-oriented, naturally curious, and confident working independently to drive resolution in a fast-paced environment.


Business Systems Analyst | Day-to-Day

  • Triage and resolve data issues within the Pay-Per-Use program by identifying root causes and directing them to the appropriate teams.
  • Maintain and manage the team’s Jira board, including issue tracking, documentation, and validation of outcomes.
  • Troubleshoot and update Tableau reports (10–15 dashboards), ensuring accuracy and relevance of the displayed data.
  • Write and modify SQL queries to investigate issues, validate fixes, and extract data as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with internal finance, technical, and business stakeholders to support billing and revenue-related processes.
  • Contribute to chatbot proof-of-concept development by providing data insights and supporting testing activities.


Business Systems Analyst | Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst, or similar analytical role.
  • Proficient in writing SQL queries for data investigation and analysis.
  • Hands-on experience modifying and troubleshooting Tableau dashboards and working with backend data sources.
  • Skilled in managing issues in Jira and working across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Familiarity with navigating Salesforce and SAP for data verification (no development or admin experience required).

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Mobile Android Sênior – Kotlin Multiplatform
description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Mobile Android Sênior para atuar em um projeto temporário (contrato de 3 a 4 meses) , com foco em Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP), arquiteturas modernas de apps móveis e integração com GraphQL.

Você será responsável por evoluir nossos aplicativos Android e contribuir na estrutura multiplataforma, garantindo alta performance, estabilidade e experiência de uso consistente.

Procuramos alguém com sólido domínio técnico, mentalidade de produto, e visão arquitetural, capaz de entregar soluções escaláveis e manuteníveis em um ambiente colaborativo e ágil.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações mobile Android com Kotlin e Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) , compartilhando código entre plataformas quando aplicável.
  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas escaláveis e reativas (Clean Architecture, MVVM, MVI).
  • Integrar com APIs GraphQL de forma eficiente e segura.
  • Assegurar performance, estabilidade e responsividade das aplicações.
  • Escrever código limpo, modular e testável , com atenção à manutenibilidade e boas práticas de engenharia.
  • Garantir qualidade de software com testes automatizados (unitários, instrumentados e end-to-end).
  • Participar ativamente de discussões de arquitetura , code reviews e decisões técnicas .
  • Colaborar com designers, product managers e engenheiros backend para construir experiências consistentes e de alto impacto.


Essenciais (ênfase da vaga):

  • Experiência sólida com Kotlin e desenvolvimento Android nativo (Jetpack, Compose, Coroutines, Flow).
  • Vivência prática em Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) e Ktor para compartilhamento de código entre plataformas.
  • Domínio de arquiteturas modernas (MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture).
  • Integração com APIs GraphQL .
  • Cultura de testes automatizados (JUnit, Espresso, Kaspresso, MockK).
  • Conhecimento sólido em injeção de dependência (Hilt, Koin).


Importantes (secundários, mas valorizados):

  • Conhecimento em Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile (KMM) com integração iOS.
  • Experiência em consumo offline-first (Room, SQLDelight, caching).
  • Vivência com Compose Multiplatform .
  • Conhecimento em design system e componentização cross-platform .


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em aplicações de grande escala e alto tráfego .
  • Participação em times ágeis com forte cultura de engenharia e DevOps.


Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Todas as nossas oportunidades são Afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Valorizamos a diversidade independentemente de identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade ou qualquer outro aspecto.


Aviso de Proteção de Dados

Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos.

Caso haja alguma dúvida relacionada à proteção de dados ou qualquer aspecto envolvendo o tratamento realizado, você pode entrar em contato por meio do canal:

title: Data Solutions Architect (inglês fluente)
description:
#VAGA REMOTA para Arquiteto de Dados / Tech Lead

Modelo Contractor/PJ via Deel – Longo Prazo

Inglês Fluente Obrigatório

Atuação 100% remota (alinhamento com fuso dos EUA)


A Stefanini LATAM está apoiando uma organização global em Data & Analytics na criação de seu hub nearshore para ampliar a cobertura operacional em horários críticos.

Buscamos um(a) Arquiteto de Dados ou Tech Lead em Dados com perfil Técnico-Estratégico para atuar como líder técnico da operação nearshore e referência de arquitetura em um ambiente corporativo de larga escala.


Responsabilidades Técnicas

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de dados corporativa, garantindo padronização, escalabilidade e governança.
  • Modelagem de dados (conceitual, lógico e físico) para data lakes, data warehouses e data platforms modernos.
  • Liderar o desenho e gerenciamento de pipelines de ingestão (batch e CDC), replicação e transformação.
  • Avaliar performance de ingestão, linhagem, versionamento e qualidade de dados.
  • Integrar sistemas hospedados em ambientes híbridos (GCP, Azure, SQL Server).
  • Apoiar iniciativas avançadas (ML/GenAI/Analytics), garantindo readiness e arquitetura adequada.
  • Ser o ponto estratégico do nearshore para decisões de arquitetura, garantindo alinhamento com times da Índia, EUA e demais hubs.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas escaláveis e sustentáveis.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida como Arquiteto(a) de Dados, Data Solutions Architect ou Enterprise Data Architect.
  • Forte domínio de arquitetura moderna de dados (medallion, lakehouse, data mesh, pipelines distribuídos).
  • Experiência prática com:
  • Azure Data Factory (ADF)
  • SQL Server (OLTP/OLAP)
  • CDC / replicação de dados – preferencialmente Click Replicate
  • Integração entre GCP e ecossistemas Microsoft
  • Conhecimento avançado de modelagem, governança, versionamento e gestão de ciclo de vida de dados.
  • Fluência em inglês (interação diária com lideranças globais).
  • Capacidade comprovada de tomada de decisão técnica, liderança e direcionamento arquitetural.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Microsoft Fabric .
  • Background em plataformas analíticas e machine learning.
  • Atuação em ambientes corporativos complexos e distribuídos.



Se você possui senioridade técnica, visão arquitetural e deseja liderar a evolução de uma plataforma de dados global, este é o desafio ideal.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Front-End | Hablla
description:
Sobre a Hablla

A Hablla é a plataforma líder em Marketing Conversacional Integrado (MCI) — uma evolução do RevOps que conecta Marketing, Vendas, Atendimento, Customer Success e Business Performance em um único fluxo conversacional.

Nosso propósito é redefinir a comunicação entre marcas e pessoas, utilizando Inteligência Artificial Generativa e automação inteligente para transformar dados em resultados concretos.

Se você busca desafios técnicos, quer trabalhar com produtos digitais de alta escala e participar da construção de uma solução proprietária inovadora essa parceria é para você.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver interfaces modernas e de alta performance utilizando React.js e TypeScript , com foco em escalabilidade, responsividade e experiência do usuário.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares de UX, backend, dados e produto, em um ambiente de desenvolvimento ágil.
  • Participar da definição e manutenção do Design System e dos padrões de arquitetura front-end.
  • Implementar e manter o gerenciamento de estado utilizando Redux com Redux-Saga .
  • Garantir a qualidade técnica do código, seguindo boas práticas de clean code e componentização.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com React.js , TypeScript , HTML5 , CSS3/Tailwind e consumo de APIs REST.
  • Domínio de Redux e Redux-Saga .
  • Experiência com Vite ou Next.js .
  • Conhecimento de Git e GitHub para versionamento e colaboração.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de Clean Architecture , Hooks , componentização e testes unitários .
  • Mentalidade orientada a produto, com foco em performance e experiência do usuário.


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com integrações omnichannel (WhatsApp, Meta, e-mail e telefonia).
  • Experiência com Figma e colaboração com times de UX/UI.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas colaborativos em tempo real .
  • Interesse em IA aplicada à interface e personalização de jornada do usuário.
  • Ter trabalhado em ferramentas de CRM e/ou Omnichannel.


O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente 100% remoto e colaborativo.
  • Cultura ágil, horizontal e orientada a resultados.
  • Contato direto com os founders e time de produto.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento em uma startup em expansão internacional .

title: Senior Developer/Architect - .NET/C# and Azure
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Key Responsibilities

• Design and develop end-to-end solutions using Azure services including Azure Container Apps, CosmosDB, Azure Functions, and Azure DevOps.

• Build scalable, secure, and maintainable cloud-native applications.

• Lead technical design sessions and create architecture diagrams and documentation.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, security, and UI/UX.

• Present technical solutions and roadmaps to stakeholders and leadership.


Qualifications

• Hands-on experience in software development and solution architecture.

• Deep expertise in Azure PaaS services, especially CosmosDB, Azure Container Apps, and Azure Functions.

• Strong background in backend development (.NET, C#, or similar), REST APIs, and microservices.

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and DevOps practices.

• Excellent presentation and communication skills—able to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Familiarity with AI/ML integration and secure cloud architecture is a plus.

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Contratação PJ

Atuação remota


Sobre o projeto

  • Projeto estratégico com grande volume de dados e foco em arquiteturas de baixo custo .
  • Atuação em iniciativas críticas relacionadas à transformação e integração de dados.


Nossa stack

  • GCP (BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, Storage, Cloud Run, Compute Engine, DataProc, DataFlow)
  • Cursor para desenvolvimento diário
  • Python para processamento de dados e automações
  • APIs com Flask e FastAPI


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados em GCP .
  • Implementar estratégias para redução de custos e aumento de performance.
  • Criar serviços e APIs para integração de dados.
  • Trabalhar com arquiteturas escaláveis e eficientes.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com GCP e seus principais serviços.
  • Forte domínio em Python para processamento de dados.
  • Vivência com arquiteturas econômicas e escaláveis .
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento como Cursor .
  • Perfil proativo e orientado à solução.

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
About Turing



Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at



Role Overview:



We have an exciting opportunity for a Payroll Administrator to help with our growing global payroll processes. This role will own the Brazil payroll process but will be hands-on in many other aspects of our payroll operations through data collection, process streamlining, and entity creation. This is a great growth role for anyone wanting to expand their payroll career in a global setting.

Our ideal candidate is a hands-on self-starter who is analytical and methodical, with 4+ years of experience in payroll operations. We also value integrity, team spirit, and strong organizational skills.

This role is fully remote and based in Brazil, however, this role will be dealing with payroll across geographies as we grow.



Responsibilities:



  • Process Brazil payroll for employees in the Deel platform. This will include the monthly regular cycle and all off-cycle payrolls as needed for new hires/terminations.
  • Manage workflow to ensure incoming and outgoing payroll data is processed timely and accurately. Serve as the main point of contact for the Deel payroll team.
  • Remittance of Brazilian employee payroll deposits and monthly FGTS/INSS payroll tax payments.
  • Ability to understand union agreement(s) and serve as a point of contact for employee and/or vendor questions in relation.
  • Knowledge of Brazil payroll tax compliance to ensure the accuracy of system settings and processed transactions.
  • Help to ensure payroll-related tax account registrations are completed as needed.
  • Work closely with our internal accounting department to provide support on payroll-related questions or documentation as needed.
  • Own data collection, entries, and accuracy across multiple systems that impact global payroll operations.
  • Assist employees with inquiries related to payroll matters.
  • Assist with month-end, quarter-end, and year-end payroll processes and related tax reconciliations.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with business partners (People/Benefits/Finance) for process improvements and efficiencies.
  • Create and/or maintain payroll documentation as it relates to processing, operational procedures, compliance, and other payroll-related matters.
  • Assist in ad-hoc duties when required (ie. audits, payroll backup for other entities, external payment operations, etc.)



Skills/Qualifications Required:



  • Minimum of 2-4 years of payroll processing.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with team members and other stakeholders.
  • Exposure to a SOX-regulated environment is preferred but not required.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and proven to have excellent time management skills to deliver results in a fast-paced environment. Strong organizational skills; ability to meet deadlines across multiple tasks.
  • Recent processing experience with Deel or other third-party payroll providers. Exposure to ADP Workforce Now, HiBob, Slack, Jira, and Jibble preferred.
  • Knowledge of Sao Paulo Union agreements and Brazilian labor laws; must be able to read agreements and relay relevant information to team(s) as needed.
  • Strong communication skills, written/verbal, and the ability to interact with employees at all levels. Must be proficient in written and verbal English. Bilingual Portuguese preferred.
  • Strong MS Excel skills required (VLOOKUP’s, Pivot Tables, etc.)



Advantages of joining Turing:


  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role: we’re looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing AI team!


About the Role

As an ML Engineer on our team, you will design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models that power autonomous exception resolution, anomaly detection, and explainable insights. You’ll work hands-on with multiple LLM ecosystems like OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA. You will implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, develop prompt engineering and safety techniques, and integrate memory and explainability into agentic workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models for production.
  • Build RAG pipelines using vector databases and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and MCP.
  • Develop prompt engineering, optimization, and safety techniques for agentic LLM interactions.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to maintain data pipelines for ML workloads.
  • Conduct feature engineering and embeddings generation on structured and unstructured data.
  • Implement model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines.
  • Explore emerging LLM/SLM architectures and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, data science, product, and engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in ML engineering.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
  • 3+ years building and deploying ML systems.
  • English advance (B2)
  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs/SLMs including fine-tuning, prompt design, and inference optimization.
  • Familiarity with at least two of the following: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta LLaMA.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and RAG pipelines.
  • Experience working with both structured and unstructured data at scale.
  • Understanding of SQL and distributed data frameworks like Spark or Ray.
  • Deep knowledge of ML lifecycle: data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, AutoGen).
  • Understanding of AI safety, guardrails, and explainability.
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/LLM solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
  • Background in anomaly detection, fraud/risk modeling, or behavioral analytics.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or research publications.


UST is waiting for you!

description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role: we’re looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing AI team!


About the Role

As an ML Engineer on our team, you will design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models that power autonomous exception resolution, anomaly detection, and explainable insights. You’ll work hands-on with multiple LLM ecosystems like OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA. You will implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, develop prompt engineering and safety techniques, and integrate memory and explainability into agentic workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models for production.
  • Build RAG pipelines using vector databases and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and MCP.
  • Develop prompt engineering, optimization, and safety techniques for agentic LLM interactions.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to maintain data pipelines for ML workloads.
  • Conduct feature engineering and embeddings generation on structured and unstructured data.
  • Implement model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines.
  • Explore emerging LLM/SLM architectures and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, data science, product, and engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in ML engineering.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
  • 3+ years building and deploying ML systems.
  • English advance (B2)
  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs/SLMs including fine-tuning, prompt design, and inference optimization.
  • Familiarity with at least two of the following: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta LLaMA.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and RAG pipelines.
  • Experience working with both structured and unstructured data at scale.
  • Understanding of SQL and distributed data frameworks like Spark or Ray.
  • Deep knowledge of ML lifecycle: data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, AutoGen).
  • Understanding of AI safety, guardrails, and explainability.
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/LLM solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
  • Background in anomaly detection, fraud/risk modeling, or behavioral analytics.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or research publications.

title: Deployment Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Manage continuous delivery and configuration of SAP Ariba Cloud products using modern deployment tools.
  • Respond quickly to deployment requests and provide technical support for the SAP Ariba suite.
  • Collaborate with engineering subject matter experts to ensure seamless operations.
  • Handle user tickets and change requests within defined SLAs.
  • Automate manual tasks to improve scalability and efficiency.
  • Lead complex deployment projects including new site setups and disaster recovery planning.
  • Manage certificate renewals and troubleshoot related issues.
  • Document SOPs and apply ITIL best practices.


Requiriments and Qualifications:


  • Experience in a Unix/Linux environment.
  • Familiar with SAP Ariba Cloud products
  • Proven experience in 24x7 enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with cloud provisioning (preferably GCP and AWS).
  • Proficiency in Terraform and CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Artifactory, Docker, Vault.
  • Development experience in Python, Go, or Groovy.
  • Strong knowledge of system applications (Apache, DNS, SSH, TCP/IP, NFS).
  • Deep understanding of OS internals and file system structures.
  • Experience with certificate management and scripting (Perl, Python, Shell).
  • Basic knowledge of HANA database administration.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and multitasking skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in MIS, CS, or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced English

title: Sales Manager -  Nutraceutical Ingredients ( LATAM)
description:
Sales Manager - Nutraceutical Ingredients ( LATAM)


Location: Brazil (Remote)


Territory: Latin America


About the Role


We’re seeking a Sales Manager to drive growth across LATAM. You will sell nutraceutical ingredients to the dietary supplement and functional food & beverage industries, building a high-quality pipeline and long-term customer relationships.


Responsibilities

• Manage and grow key accounts across LATAM, fostering senior-level relationships with brand owners, CDMOs/contract manufacturers, and distributors.

• Develop and execute country- and segment-level territory plans to capture new business.

• Present nutraceutical ingredients to customers, clearly articulating benefits, applications, and go-to-market plans.

• Collaborate with technical, regulatory, and marketing teams to deliver tailored solutions and product launches.

• Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify white space and protect share.

• Meet and exceed quarterly/annual sales targets with accurate forecasting and disciplined CRM hygiene.

• Represent the company at regional trade shows, conferences, and industry events.

• Provide technical/product support to customers in coordination with internal teams.

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of regional regulations and standards (e.g., ANVISA, COFEPRIS, INVIMA).


Requirements

• 5+ years of B2B sales experience in nutraceutical ingredients within LATAM.

• Strong understanding of nutraceutical ingredients and their applications in dietary supplements and functional F&B.

• Proven ability to prospect, build pipelines, negotiate, and close across multiple countries.

• Language: Fluent Portuguese and strong Spanish; English is a plus.

• Self-starter comfortable working remotely; excellent territory/time management.

• Based in Brazil with willingness to travel across LATAM as required.

• Proficiency with MS Office and CRM (ZOHO preferred).

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About the Role

Our client is loong for a highly skilled Full Stack Engineer to join a global product-focused technology team responsible for building large-scale web platforms used by millions of users. This role offers the opportunity to work in a collaborative, engineering-driven environment with strong ownership, modern cloud architectures, and end-to-end autonomy.


What You Will Do

  • Design and build responsive, web-based applications and learning tools used at scale.
  • Work closely with engineering, product, design, sales, and marketing teams to deliver impactful user-centric features.
  • Own the full software development lifecycle: architecture, development, testing, deployment, observability, and maintenance.
  • Implement Infrastructure-as-Code and monitoring best practices to ensure highly reliable applications.
  • Collaborate with a high-performing engineering group built around autonomy and extreme ownership.


What You Bring

Mandatory Skills

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Java , ideally with Spring or Spring Boot.
  • Experience with Angular (preferred) or React.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful services , microservices, and distributed systems.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines , automated testing, and DevOps-oriented workflows.
  • Knowledge of databases (SQL or NoSQL).
  • Experience with AWS services for cloud-native application development.
  • Understanding of Docker and containerization concepts.
  • Experience with observability tools to monitor application health.
  • Solid understanding of backend engineering, with some experience across the full stack (front-end + backend).


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Terraform (highly desirable).
  • Experience developing B2B or B2C product engineering solutions at scale.
  • Experience building accessible, high-performance, responsive web applications .
  • Knowledge of distributed caching solutions (e.g., Redis).
  • Experience deploying applications on Tomcat or similar application servers.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.

title: Java Full stack Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Fullstack Java Developer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Solid experience in Java 8+ and frameworks such as Spring/Spring Boot.

Technical knowledge of Java 7 or 8, JSP - Java Server Pages, JSF - Java Server Faces, JBOSS, Primefaces, and Wildfly.

Advanced knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis).

Experience in front-end development with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.js.

Experience with REST APIs, authentication, and authorization (OAuth2, JWT).

Knowledge of version control tools (Git) and continuous integration pipelines.

Experience with microservices architecture and messaging (Kafka, RabbitMQ).

Proficiency in automated testing (JUnit, Mockito, Cypress, Jest).

Familiarity with Docker environments and orchestration (Kubernetes).


Desirable skills:

Experience with cloud computing (AWS, Azure, GCP)

Knowledge of serverless architecture and Lambda functions

Java or Cloud certifications

ID:

title: Contracting Manager (Activities & Experiences)
description:
Contracting Manager (supplier negotiations)

Location – Brazil

Full Time


About Us

HBX Group is the world’s leading technological partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard-to-reach high-value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course, we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality.


Job Summary:

As the face of HBX Group to our suppliers, you will develop strong relationships with our suppliers for a defined portfolio of activities within a specific geographic area.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the contracting process with our clients in a B2B and B2C environment, focused on signing the most competitive rates for HBX Group.
  • Negotiate contract renewal conditions such as: rate, inventory, offers, release periods, marketing contributions, overrides, cancellation policy.
  • Monitor the performance of each hotel working closely with the Yield Manager to ensure competitiveness and availability is not an issue.
  • Act as the face-to-face key point contact for experienced suppliers and develop and maintain excellent relationships with them.
  • Support the resolution of major supplier or client complaints, negotiating the most suitable solution to maintain good service and a positive relationship with them.
  • Ensure the supplier has a clear understanding of HBX Group value proposition and marketing tools to optimize the income of each contract.


Skillset and Experience Required:

  • Strong negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience in contracting and supplier management within the travel or activities industry.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to analyze performance metrics and implement improvement strategies.
  • Proficiency in relevant software tools and systems.
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese, Spanish additional languages are a plus.


At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good.

We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference.


You will have the opportunity to work for a company that is going through significant change in becoming the world´s leading travel services provider. We are looking for people that are ready to ride the wave in this exciting journey.

title: Data Warehouse Architect
description:
Databricks Data Warehouse ArchitectAbout the role:

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitor data jobs and resolve performance bottlenecks or failures across environments.
Required Skills & Experience: Databricks / Lakehouse Architecture
  • End-to-end setup of Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog
  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals , file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations
AWS Native Integration
  • Deep experience with AWS Glue , S3 , Redshift Spectrum , Lambda , and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps
  • Proficient in monitoring tools like CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic for data pipelines
Bonus/Nice to Have:
  • Experience supporting gaming or real-time analytics workloads
  • Familiarity with Airflow , Kafka , or EventBridge
  • Exposure to data privacy and compliance practices (GDPR, CCPA)
Other Details:
  • Location : Latin America (LATAM) region - Remote, USA - Remote
  • Length : 1+ Year

Client : Gaming giant

T

his is not a role in instructional design, curriculum/content development or training delivery or

operations.


High-level skills and experience

• Strong consultative mindset and consulting skill set with a strong point-of-view on solutions and

recommendations.

• Strategic, ‘big picture’ thinking and connecting the dots.

• Ability to understand the ‘why’ along with the ‘what’ and ‘how’ of a partner need (i.e., well- rounded learning plans that drive business outcomes rather than just chasing headcount/numbers)

• Strong commercial awareness/business acumen of the client’s and channel partner’s business.

• Ability to align learning with client and partner ROI and business drivers.

• Thought leadership with new ideas, strategies, framework, processes to drive results.

• Executive presence and comfortable with public speaking (in-person and virtual) with senior

stakeholders and large audiences

• Data analytics (ability to dig into trends and forecast) and data story telling.

• Technical prowess to understand data/AI/cloud/technical knowledge.

• Highly collaborative across various business functions/senior stakeholder management.

• Proactive and independent, ability to excel in a fast-paced environment while working from vision through execution.


Expected tasks and responsibilities

• Execute frameworks to assess capability and capacity workforce skill gaps in partner organizations.

• Conduct partner needs analysis (discovery and scoping at business, technical and learning levels)

• Enabling consulting conversations with business leaders in partner teams to understand their

business drivers.

• Propose strategic learning plans to all internal and external stakeholders.

• Prescribe relevant learning based on scope and workload (such as certifications, solutions, products,

etc.)

• Build custom partner learning plans, where required, based on the results of scoping/needs analysis and business priority.

• Monitor learner progress and detect any issues.

• Create and present Quarterly/Monthly Business Reviews with senior L&D/Business/Technology

stakeholders

• Monitor and analyze learning stats for data-driven decisions.

• Explore business problems and create different solution models.

• Make recommendations for improvement and present to partners and internal stakeholders.

• Some travel involved within Brazil to client and partner locations.


Qualifications/Requirements

We are looking for individuals with the following qualifications, skills, and experiences:

• 5+ years relevant experience being an L&D consultant or in any business facing consultant role driving outcomes.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering and Computer Science, or a related field (required)

• Masters candidates (preferred)

• Cloud Digital Leader or Generative AI Leader (GAIL) certifications, preferred but not mandatory

• Experience in the channel partner ecosystem highly preferred


All candidates must be bilingual: Native Portuguese and Advance English verbal and written.

title: Site Reliability Engineer Sr
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Site Reliability Engineer Sr (SRE Sr)

Contratação CLT


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Criar, manter e escalar soluções resilientes, de alta disponibilidade e performance em cloud.
  • Implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD com foco em automatização;
  • Automatizar tudo que for possível (IaC, pipelines, deploys).
  • Otimizar performance, definir e monitorar SLOs junto ao time de produto.
  • Atuar em incidentes e ajudar a reduzir MTTR.


Qualificações Exigidas:

  • Experiência prévia usando melhores práticas em SRE;
  • Experiência em ambientes Multi-cloud (OCI ou AWS) ou híbridos;
  • Atuação com CI/CD (GitLab, ArgoCD e similares);
  • Experiência solida com Infrastructure as Code (Terraform e similares)
  • Automação e scripting (Python, Go ou Bash/Shell);
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana LGTM, OTel).
  • Domínio de containers e Kubernetes.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Chaos Engineering;
  • Contribuições em projetos open source.
  • Certificações em Cloud.

title: SAP BPC Architect
description:
About the Company: Genpact (NYSE: G) is a global professional services and solutions firm delivering outcomes that shape the future. Our 125,000+ people across 30+ countries are driven by our innate curiosity, entrepreneurial agility, and desire to create lasting value for clients. Powered by our purpose the relentless pursuit of a world that works better for people we serve and transform leading enterprises, including the Fortune Global 500, with our deep business and industry knowledge, digital operations services, and expertise in data, technology, and AI.


About the Role: Genpact is urgently looking for a strong Consultant for one of our precious clients in USA. If you are interested kindly share profile at


Title: SAP BPC Specialist

Location: Uberlandia, Brazil / REMOTE

Duration: Contract


Responsibilities:

  • Bridging Finance and Tech - FP&A knowhow with SAP functional knowledge can effectively translate financial req into system configurations, for planning, reporting, and forecasting (all three or per their current challenges)
  • System-Driven Financial Accuracy - SAP BPC and SAC requires a deep understanding of financial data flows, hierarchies, and consolidation logic— by someone who understands both finance principles and SAP structures.
  • Financial Acumen - FP&A expertise; understanding of P&L drivers, budgeting logic, and variance analysis—critical for validating system outputs and ensuring financial integrity in reporting
  • Root-Cause Resolution Capability - Key to this role is the ability to reverse-engineer financial reports with data issues, determine whether the problem is from template design or source system data, and coordinate fixes with IT or finance accordingly.
  • Sustained System Enhancement & Governing : Improvement of SAP-based planning and reporting processes would need someone who understands both system limitations and financial controls within FP&A (though mostly i think this will be managed at either the project level or by Thuy or someone in the team)





Best Regards,

Manohar Swamy

DTAI Hiring Team, Genpact

title: Executivo de Vendas (Brasil)
description:
Sobre a greenmetrics.ai


A greenmetrics.ai desenvolve soluções tecnológicas para ajudar cidades na adaptação climática e sustentabilidade ambiental.


Desenvolvemos sistemas de sensores inteligentes e análises de dados avançadas para coletar e processar informações ambientais, contribuindo diretamente para aumentar a resiliência das cidades frente a enchentes e alagamentos.


Vislumbramos um futuro em que a tecnologia e a engenhosidade humana atuam como aliadas do mundo natural, um futuro em que os dados orientam nosso caminho rumo a um modo de vida mais sustentável, equilibrado e resiliente, preservando o delicado equilíbrio do planeta para as próximas gerações.


Somos uma startup independente e lucrativa, com tecnologia comprovada e sistemas em operação em mais de 15 cidades em Portugal e no Brasil, em rápida expansão.


Sobre a vaga


Esta é uma oportunidade para quem quer vender com propósito e ter impacto positivo no mundo real. 


Como Executivo de Vendas na greenmetrics.ai, você será a ponte entre nossas soluções tecnológicas e as necessidades urgentes das cidades brasileiras para melhorar sua capacidade de adaptação a eventos climáticos extremos. 


No dia a dia, você vai prospectar novas oportunidades, visitar clientes, gerir o pipeline de leads, preparar propostas e fechar contratos que contribuem diretamente para criar cidades mais resilientes. 


Seu trabalho vai contribuir para apoiar autoridades de emergência a priorizar áreas de risco, monitorar níveis de água em tempo real e tomar decisões informadas durante eventos extremos que se tornam cada vez mais frequentes e severos.


Suas responsabilidades


  • Prospectar e qualificar oportunidades na Região Sul do Brasil (RS/SC/PR).
  • Agendar e conduzir visitas presenciais a municípios, apresentando casos de uso para monitorização hidrológica e detecção antecipada de inundações.
  • Gerir o pipeline no CRM, garantindo dados atualizados e previsões de receita estimada.
  • Preparar provas de conceito com leads estratégicos e elaborar propostas comerciais.
  • Negociar condições comerciais e acompanhar processos de compras públicas.
  • Fechar contratos e garantir a transição para implementação e sucesso do cliente.
  • Manter relacionamento com líderes municipais e fomentar expansão de contas.
  • Representar a empresa em eventos, reforçando credibilidade técnica e institucional.
  • Coletar feedback do cliente para o time de produto/engenharia.


O que procuramos


  • +5 anos em vendas B2B ou para o setor público, preferencialmente em soluções tecnológicas ou SaaS.
  • Histórico comprovado de performance com superação de meta, condução de ciclos de venda longos, contratos de alto valor, cases documentados e referências de clientes.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, condução de reuniões executivas e apresentações técnico-comerciais.
  • Experiência com ferramentas CRM e gestão de pipeline, métricas de funil e forecast.
  • Negociação e gestão de stakeholders com postura colaborativa e foco em resultado.
  • Autonomia e disciplina operacional para planejar rotas, viajar para visitas comerciais e cumprir agendas de campo com eficiência.
  • Base na região de Porto Alegre ou Florianópolis e disponibilidade para viajar (mandatório).
  • Formação em engenharia, hidrologia ou tecnologia é desejável.


O que oferecemos


  • Salário fixo + comissões agressivas.
  • Produto comprovado, de alto impacto social e ambiental e forte proposta de valor.
  • Playbooks, ferramentas e mentoria do nosso time técnico e comercial.
  • Ambiente hands-on, autonomia e impacto concreto e mensurável.


Como se candidatar


Sabemos que você tem uma rotina intensa e respeitamos seu tempo, então basta compartilhar seu currículo atualizado com os detalhes relevantes sobre sua formação e experiência.


Inclua: sua experiência em vendas B2B ou setor público, exemplos de métodos e abordagens comerciais que você utilizou e principais resultados obtidos.


Prazo de candidatura: 25/nov

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack (Node.js + React Native)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

— Atuar em um assessment técnico com foco em análise profunda da base atual das aplicações Web e Mobile.

— Revisar código das aplicações desenvolvidas em Node.js e React Native , avaliando qualidade, padrões utilizados e aderência às boas práticas.

— Identificar bugs, riscos, dívidas técnicas e oportunidades de melhoria técnica e arquitetural.

— Mapear integrações, APIs, serviços e dependências do sistema, garantindo entendimento completo da estrutura atual.

— Documentar os achados, pontos críticos e recomendações, apoiando o time técnico na definição dos próximos passos.

— Contribuir com insights técnicos para melhoria contínua do código e estabilidade da aplicação.


O que você precisa ter

— Forte experiência prática com Node.js e React Native (Web e Mobile).

— Vivência consistente com revisão de código (code review) e análise estrutural de aplicações.

— Conhecimento sólido de boas práticas , padrões de desenvolvimento e qualidade de código.

— Capacidade analítica para identificar problemas em bases legadas, arquiteturas pouco padronizadas e integrações complexas.

— Experiência com APIs, integrações e entendimento de dependências técnicas.

— Boa comunicação para documentar achados e conduzir discussões técnicas.


Desejável

— Experiência com arquitetura limpa, padrões de projeto ou refatoração estruturada.

— Vivência em ambientes com múltiplas integrações (REST, microserviços, filas, etc.).

— Conhecimento em TypeScript.

— Experiência prévia com auditoria de código, due diligence técnica ou assessment de sistemas.


Perfil esperado

— Olhar crítico e foco em melhoria contínua.

— Mentalidade estruturada, organizada e detalhista.

— Proatividade para propor soluções e identificar riscos técnicos.

— Autonomia e capacidade de analisar ambientes complexos.

— Curiosidade técnica e vontade de elevar o nível da base existente.


Onde você vai trabalhar

Remoto.
